items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: We flew out to California in a private plane, together with Count Basie and Gladys Knight and the Pips

ctx.x: You called him in Tucson when you were in L.A.

In L.A., yeah. I went with Tom Jones in '69 and '70, on the road show. We flew out to California in a private plane, together with Count Basie and Gladys Knight and the Pips, playing the (?)... I mean, it was a national tour, and Basie would leave at a certain point to go on his tour, and we had to pick up another band, and then later
